contracts: Shared borrowed non-Clone input can be captured by multiple cases without copying or requiring a static lifetime
Group path distinguishes identical leaf names; selection uses the complete identity
Explicit validate_registration rejects duplicate full identities without executing workloads
Group defaults inherit by field, nearest child overrides win, and explicit false/zero values are preserved

native_differences: Criterion executes each case during registration and finish/drop generates group summaries. Airbug registers lazily and emits reports when Suite runs.
Criterion validates uniqueness during every registration. Airbug exposes validate_registration for whole-suite uniqueness, invoked by the CLI; low-level selected execution checks selected cases.
Criterion mutable group setters affect subsequent registrations. Airbug scoped defaults apply to entries created by that closure, with nested explicit settings taking precedence.
Numeric option-domain differences are tracked separately in numeric-domains.json.
